predictions.correct: Not the right data? Edit your history

timers.title: Timers & check-ins
timers.explanation: A gentle check after 30 minutes of nursing or 2 hours of sleep. These are check-ins, not recommended durations. Sessions keep running until you stop them.
timers.liveNote: See elapsed time on your Lock Screen and Dynamic Island on supported iPhones. Tap to adjust or stop the session. Enable Live Activities in iPhone settings if needed.
timers.nativeOnly: Timer notifications are available in the mobile app. Live Activities require iOS 16.2 or later.
timers.permission: Allow notifications in your phone settings to receive timer check-ins.
timers.unavailable: Timer notifications need the latest mobile build.
timers.body: Forgot to stop? Open the session to set the actual end time. We have kept your timer running.
timers.alreadyEnded: Already finished? Set the end time

nursingAmount.label: Milk amount · optional
nursingAmount.note: Enter an amount you know or want to record. The timer does not measure milk intake.

ageContext.title: Age & your baby’s rhythm
ageContext.sleep: Typical sleep at this age: {{min}}–{{max}} hours in 24 hours, including naps.
ageContext.varies: Sleep needs vary widely at this age.
ageContext.personal: Your next-session estimates come from your logs. Age guidance describes a broad reference, not an exact next nap or feed time.

refresh.learningBody: A few more sessions will help us spot your baby’s routine.
refresh.emptySearchHint: Try a different search or filter, or add a session.

sleepAI.title: Sleep insights
sleepAI.intro: A gentler way to understand your baby’s rhythm.
sleepAI.learningBody: Keep logging sleep and wake-up times. We’ll show a window when there is enough recent, consistent history.
sleepAI.reviewBody: A timer may have been left running, or some times overlap. Correct the times before using these insights.
sleepAI.staleBody: There is no recent wake-up time. Add the latest sleep session to update your insights.
sleepAI.explanation: Your baby’s recent sleep and wake-up times shape this estimate. It adapts when you add or correct a session.
sleepAI.limits: These are estimates from your logs, not a prescribed schedule. Follow your baby’s cues. Missing logs can affect the result.
sleepAI.privacy: Computed on this device. No sleep logs are sent to an external AI service.
sleepAI.age: Age reference · {{min}}–{{max}} hours per 24 hours, including naps. This does not set the next nap time.
sleepAI.ageVaries: Sleep needs vary, especially in the first months. We do not assign an exact nap time from age alone.

apple.phoneRequired: Open Nursing Queen on your iPhone, then try again.
apple.notConfirmed: Action not confirmed. Refresh before trying again.

homeSetup.settingsHint: Choose the activities that fit your routine

solids.title: Solid foods
solids.intro: Your food notebook. Choose what to try and record what baby tasted, once.
solids.empty: No foods here yet. Try the catalogue or a different search.
solids.error: Could not save. Check the details and try again. For photos, allow access in your phone settings.
solids.notFound: This meal could not be found.
solids.confirmDelete: Delete this meal? Tap to confirm
solids.positiveQuantity: Enter a positive amount, or leave the field empty.

foodAI.title: Recognize food
foodAI.intro: Take a photo of the plate, then review and edit the suggested foods.
foodAI.privacy: By tapping Analyze, you send this photo to our AI service (OpenAI). Your baby’s name, birth date and journal are not sent. Avoid faces in the photo.
foodAI.reviewHint: These are suggestions. Correct names, remove foods or add missing items. Enter amounts on the next screen. Nothing has been saved to the journal yet.
foodAI.empty: No food recognized. Add it manually or try another photo.
foodAI.not_configured: AI recognition is not activated yet. You can enter your meal manually.
foodAI.too_large: This photo is too large. Crop it or choose a smaller photo.
foodAI.limit: Today’s analysis limit has been reached. You can enter your meal manually.
foodAI.permission: Allow camera or photo access in your phone settings.
foodAI.unavailable: The analysis did not complete. Try again or add the foods manually.
